C1835.title: Man Sentenced to 11 Years for "Buy-Real-Return-Fake" Fraud Against Cross-Border E-Commerce, Defrauding 2.27 Million Yuan
C1835.summary: From December 2021 to April 2024, defendant Hu registered over 30 shopping accounts and frequently ordered high-value goods priced above 10,000 yuan each (cameras, lenses, luxury bags, graphics cards) from a cross-border e-commerce platform. After receiving goods, he fabricated return reasons to claim refunds while mailing back low-value mismatched items, exploiting the no-reason return and refund-before-receipt timing gap to defraud 2.27 million yuan in refunds, then reselling the goods on secondhand platforms. In November 2024, Beijing Chaoyang Court sentenced Hu to 11 years' imprisonment for fraud.
